rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
✨ You’re doing a great job at helping your child live a good life. I know you really care! 💙

😃 How did the message above make you feel?
🌷 We all feel better when we are praised!
rows.text_2::eng:
🏆 Likewise, it’s important to learn to give praise to children!

🔄 Praising your child when they behave in a good way will make them want to behave that way more often. 

⭐ It also creates a positive and loving relationship between you and your child.

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: There are different ways to praise your child. What do you think about the following?
rows.quiz_1_question::eng: True or False: The way you praise your child does not matter because any kind of praise is effective.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng:
❌ Incorrect.

✨ How you praise your child is important. Praise should be specific, immediate, and genuine. 

🌱 You can begin by praising your child for the smallest things, such as playing by themselves quietly for 2 minutes.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng:
🎉 You are right! 

✨ How you praise your child is important. Praise should be specific, immediate, and genuine.

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
⭐ Children who are praised for good behaviour will want to keep behaving well and keep receiving praise. 

4️⃣ Here are 4 simple tips for praising your child.

rows.section_1_text::eng: 👀 Look for anything good or helpful your child does.
rows.section_2_text::eng:
🏆 Praise them and tell them specifically what they have done well.
🎉 Be enthusiastic and really mean it!
🔄 This means they are more likely to do it again.
rows.section_3_text::eng:
🌷 Look for something to praise your child for every day.
🔶 Even if it is something really small, keep doing it.
rows.section_4_text::eng:
💡 Make sure you focus on something your child has done well.
🙂You can show your praise with a big smile or words. You can also clap, hug, or tickle your child to show you appreciate them.
☀️ Keeping it positive reminds your child that you notice them and care.

rows.quiz_1_question::eng: Your home activity today is to praise your child. Can you try it today?
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng:
Amazing! 🎉
3️⃣ Look for three things that you can praise your child for every day. 
💡You can praise other adults in your household, too. Notice how they respond.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng: 💚 That's OK! Sometimes things take time.
